adapted.heading: Code adapted from other projects
intro: Parts of this agent were written in Rust from the source of the open source projects below, and the stock pages carry icons from two icon sets.
Each entry gives the project, its copyright holder and licence, the files of the agent that
contain adapted code, and what was changed. The licence text follows the entry, or is listed
under "Licence and notice texts" at the end of this file.

entries.name: The Go standard library, golang.org/x/net and golang.org/x/text
entries.used_for: The HTML tokenizer and tree builder (x/net/html), regular expression syntax (regexp/syntax), the gzip and zlib framing rules (compress/gzip, compress/zlib), strconv, strings, unicode, utf8, utf16, base64, hex, path, net, net/url, net/netip, mime/multipart, quoted-printable, net/textproto, sort, math/rand, the log function of math, net/http content sniffing and redirects, time.ParseDuration, encoding/json text rules, and the proxy environment rules of x/net/http/httpproxy. The Unicode property tables were extracted through the unicode package. Unicode normalisation was checked against x/text.
entries.changes: Rewritten in Rust. Where the agent depends on the original behaviour (accepted syntax, error texts, limits) it is kept; the rest was left out. tools/core-gen/entity/entity.go is an unchanged copy of src/html/entity.go with the package renamed; it keeps its original licence header and lives in the source repository only, not in the binary or the bundle.

entries.name: github.com/valyala/fasthttp
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) 2015-present Aliaksandr Valialkin, VertaMedia, Kirill Danshin, Erik Dubbelboer, FastHTTP Authors
entries.used_for: The HTTP/1 request head and body reader, the request and response model, the upstream header handling, the server error texts and the forwarded path normalisation.
entries.changes: Rewritten in Rust on top of tokio; the parsing rules and error texts follow the original.

entries.name: github.com/fasthttp/websocket (a fork of Gorilla WebSocket)
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) 2013 The Gorilla WebSocket Authors. All rights reserved.
entries.used_for: WebSocket framing, fragment assembly, ping, pong and close handling, read limits and deadlines.
entries.changes: Rewritten in Rust; the protocol error texts and the order of the checks follow the original.

entries.name: github.com/oschwald/geoip2-golang and github.com/oschwald/maxminddb-golang
entries.used_for: The database type check when a GeoIP database is opened and the lookup rules for IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses.
entries.changes: Rewritten in Rust over the maxminddb crate; the database decoding itself is not adapted.

entries.name: github.com/cloudflare/tableflip
entries.used_for: The PID file handling and the texts of the upgrade and ready signal. Only these follow the original; the reload itself does not use its mechanism.

entries.name: google.golang.org/grpc
entries.used_for: The texts of the HTTP CONNECT handshake with a proxy (internal/transport/proxy.go).
entries.changes: Only the error message texts and the order of the handshake follow the original; the code is new and written in Rust.

entries.name: Feather icons: shield, slash and tool
entries.used_for: The paths of three icons in the inline SVG of the stock pages: shield (the security check page), slash (the blocked page) and tool (the maintenance page).
entries.changes: The paths are unchanged; the pages set their own size, stroke width and colour.

entries.name: Lucide icon: shield-check
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) for portions of Lucide are held by Cole Bemis 2013-2022 as part of Feather (MIT). All other copyright (c) for Lucide are held by Lucide Contributors 2022.
entries.used_for: The shield with a check mark on the verification page. Its outline is the Feather shield listed above; the check mark is Lucide's.
entries.changes: The paths are unchanged; the page sets its own size, stroke width and colour.

entries.name: Public domain code
entries.url: https://github.com/geraintluff/sha256 and Howard Hinnant's date algorithms (https://howardhinnant.github.io/date_algorithms.html)
entries.copyright: None claimed: released into the public domain by their authors.
entries.used_for: A small SHA-256 function in JavaScript for the challenge page when the browser has no crypto.subtle (Geraint Luff), and the conversion between days and calendar dates (Howard Hinnant). Listed as a credit; no licence condition applies.
entries.changes: Rewritten or reformatted for this agent.

providers when it is installed and refreshes them at most once every 24 hours. WAFio does not
mirror, store or resell them, and you may not resell them. Terms of the providers apply.

entries.name: FireHOL IP reputation lists (firehol_level1, firehol_level2)
lines: The blocklist-ipsets repository has no single licence. Each list is built from
third-party sources whose own terms apply. FireHOL says: "a few of these lists may
have special licences attached. Before using them, please check their source site."
Sources and their terms:
- Spamhaus DROP and EDROP, a service of The Spamhaus Project
(https://www.spamhaus.org/drop/). Free to use with credit to The Spamhaus Project.
- DShield, SANS Internet Storm Center (https://www.dshield.org). CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/). The provider allows its use to
protect your own network and asks that the data is not resold.
- Feodo Tracker, abuse.ch (https://feodotracker.abuse.ch). CC0 1.0.
- blocklist.de (https://www.blocklist.de). No licence is stated; the lists are offered
for use at your own risk.
- GreenSnow (https://greensnow.co). Credited as a source of the lists.
- Fullbogons, Team Cymru (https://www.team-cymru.com). No terms are stated; offered as a
community service.
Your server downloads these lists straight from FireHOL's repository to protect that
server. WAFio does not mirror, store or resell them.
